title: Pirc Defense: Austrian Attack
line: White builds a wall of three center pawns; Black castles and hits the wall from the side.

steps.text: In the Austrian Attack, White pushes a third pawn forward to build a big center.
Put the bishop on g7, so you can castle next.
Castle. Your king is safe before the center opens.

also.c7c5: That strikes at once, and it is also played. This lesson castles first.

steps.text: Bring the knight to a6. From there it backs up a side pawn push.

also.b8c6: That also works. This lesson goes on with the knight on a6.

steps.text: Push the pawn on c7 two squares. It hits White's wall of pawns from the side.
Move the rook to b8. It backs up a push of the pawn on b7, to open lines on the queen's side.
steps.after: The pawn on b7 can now go forward with the rook behind it.

summary: Against the Austrian, Black castles, hits White's wall of pawns from the side and opens lines on the queen's side.
